writeup.headline: Westlake rates Sell: losses, negative cash flow and a weak share price outweigh a low sales multiple.
writeup.thesis: Westlake scores 31, a Sell, only 2 points above the Strong Sell line. Profitability is the core problem: the gross margin is 9.6%, the operating margin is -11.0% and the FCF margin is -2.4%, so quality scores 30. The balance sheet scores 16, with net debt set against negative free cash flow and cash covering only 0.37 of debt. The trend factor scores 8, with the price 24.5% below its 200-day average, 46.6% below its 52-week high and the shares 49.2 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days. Growth is the bright spot at 55: latest-quarter revenue growth of 10.8% year on year, and growth sped up by 17.6 pp, though the TTM picture is still a TTM revenue decline of 4.0%. Valuation scores 28. P/S of 0.7 is low in absolute terms, but the FCF yield is 8.1 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield. Against its own history the stock is cheap on P/S, cheaper than at 59 of the last 61 month-ends, while P/FCF and EV/EBIT are not comparable.
key_risks: Negative operating margin and free cash flow, with net debt and cash covering only 0.37 of debt
Management said Q3 2026 results will be sequentially lower as the PVC and polyethylene price gains driven by the Iran conflict faded
About $205M of pre-tax charges for closing the Cologne PVC plant, citing weak demand, high energy costs and Asian imports
Several brokers cut price targets in October, and the shares remain in a steep downtrend
An older PVC pipe antitrust matter and the DOJ probe remain in the background
what_would_change: A drop of 2 points, for example from a weak Q3 report on November 4 or further negative news, would push the rating to Strong Sell
Moving up to Hold needs 14 more points, most plausibly from a return to positive operating income and free cash flow, which would lift the quality, balance sheet and valuation scores
A sustained price recovery toward the 200-day average would lift the very low trend score of 8
Recent revenue growth turning into TTM growth and better guidance would support the growth and news scores
